children.name: Evidence
children.value: Extended Content Description Object descriptor WM/EncodingSettings at 0x1CB names "Lavf60.16.100"

findings.message: The Extended Content Description Object descriptor MediaFoundationVersion names "Media Foundation 2.112", but the Extended Content Description Object descriptor WM/EncodingSettings names "FFmpeg (Lavf60.16.100)"; other software may have rewritten the file, and kept one of them.
The last superframe ends with 4082 bits after its last frame that no frame uses, since no superframe follows to finish a frame begun in them; a decoder drops them.
